errors.evidence: The description states there are four adjacent bars per academic year, but the chart clearly shows only three bars per group, corresponding to the three categories in the legend.
The description identifies the tallest bar (light gray, for 'Общо') as the 'first' bar in the group. However, in each group, the light gray bar is the bar in the middle of the three.
